212458.overview: A surprisingly fun game, Indian Joe 1 and Schatz der Mayas was created by Lipowski Bobe and released in 1994.  An adventure game based squarely on Indiana Jones movies.

212811.overview: The objective of this head to head shooter by Michael van der Zwet is twofold as we have two sides playing against each other. One is for the alien to escape the earth or for the soldier to kill the alien in order to keep it from taking the U.F.O. technology back home.

213756.overview: Cricket Crazy is 2D sports Cricket game by Paul Dowers also released as International Cricket in 1992. Touting itself as the ultimate in cricket simulations, combining management and arcade action.

213967.overview: InvaderCraft is a Shooter game, published by CW-Publikationen, which was released in Europe in 1987.

213968.overview: Impell is a Sokoban clone that only features 8 levels and then loops back to the 1st. The game was created by Christopher January and released to the public domain in 19987.

213986.overview: This game will be instantly recognizable to those of you who have played the C64\Spectrum game, Magic Knight. The character can be moved using the joystick and interact with objects using the menu system. For example standing next to a book you may be able to examine it, by selecting examine from the main menu or pick it up and use it. Other menu options will appear only when certain criteria are met, for instance you will only be able to read most books when you are carrying them. You can speak and trade with other characters near you. It is recommended you talk to all characters. The world of Imbrium represents a dynamically changing environment, so during the course of the game objects and characters may move. If you get stuck, consider rechecking things you have previously looked at.

214018.overview: A mahjong solitaire game for one or two players published on the Spielesammlung II compilation disk. The game was created by Jean-Marc Boursot and was released in 1994.

214019.overview: The best Risk Game. This game will handle up to 4 players and up to 4 Amiga players and is much easier to play than pulling our your old Risk board, is similar to Empire for PCs. This version is an upgrade to the original version with better overall look, play and we squashed some bugs.

214020.overview: A Polish maze action game from Marcin Orîowski released by Insane Software in 1999.

214027.overview: Infiltrator is a two player action game. Each player controls a cube (one is red, the other blue) and the game is played out on the slippery floor of an arena, with a goal at either end and a line halfway through. The aim is to reach your opponent's goal without making contact with him. If there is contact, the point goes to the player whose half the contact took place in. This makes for a lot of dodging around, weighing up whether to make a mad dash for the goal, or to simply wait for a better opening without taking an immediate risk.

214029.overview: The game is made up of two distinct parts, the first is a pseudo managerial section where the player must manage their finances effectively, upgrade their car's capabilities as and when they see fit. The second part of the game is the racing, where a season consists of 16 races. Manage Team Setup, change engines, aerodynamics, tires, even chassis for best track performance. Hire and train your pit crew to speed in game services. Manage finances and check championship points. Borrow and repay the vast loans needed to keep your car in the best kit. Now enjoy the race, over 12 laps you must do your best using the mechanics available and your reflexes and preparation.

214030.overview: A Tetris clone with "specials" and lots of other additions. Ineptris is THE ultimate Tetris. Made by Robert Kihl and Martin Gunnarsson of Snarl-up Software and released as "mailware" ( a type of interactive freeware email or snail-mail something...anything to the creators) in 1997.  Special blocks are employed in this game and if finish a line with a special block something good or bad will happen. Several tunes to choose when playing Ineptris including Rock 'n' Roll, Slow Rock and Metal. There is also a Scorebandit, a lever next to your score just like the ones in Vegas. Pull it and see what happens!

214031.overview: In this Serbian turn based strategy game by V. Petrovic and the crew at Kon Tiki, after hiring a commander, click on the town you hold and select Walk to move, then skip time twice to move. The battles are shown at the top.

214032.overview: A LodeRunner clone by Raphis, created in AMOS and with music by Cypress Hill. It was handed over to public domain in 2005.

214033.overview: A Galaxian\Galaga inspired shooter that includes mechanics for capturing the alien ships, docking with motherships for repairs and upgrades and other fun additions. A little asteroid dodging is thrown in for additional variety and to give your trigger finger a break.

214034.overview:
Insectoids 2, sequel to the original game, both created by by Mark Sibly in 1993

Like all shoot-em-ups, You have to shoot the invaders what fly in from the sides of the screen, if you shoot them fast enough as they are flying in, it makes it easier to clear the level

There is occasionally a Space Ship which flies across the Sky, and if you shoot this, it drops a pickup, which you can change by shooting it on the way down, when it hits your Ship, you will get the selected powerup at that point

At the top-left you have your Lives Counter which is shown as Hearts in a Blue Circle, at the top-right is your Score and upon each round starting it will tell you what Attack Wave you are currently in

214035.overview: Interferon is a game, basically a variation on Tetris, but you must match up colors to destroy the "bugs" on the screen.  It uses 16 colors and has sounds. Select starting level, game speed, tetromino preview and easy on or off.

214036.overview: In this game you control the grey ball, the object of the game is to connect all blocks of the same colour. In other words all the red blocks must be touching as must the blue green and yellow blocks. You may push one block at a time using the ball. Grey blocks cannot be moved and server only as an obstruction. Beware of holes, if your ball falls down one or you push a block into one, you will lose a life. In later screens you will encounter filters. A filter will only allow blocks of the same colour to pass over it. Each level is timed, if you run out of time you will lose a life. Time left at the end of each level is added to your score. You start with 3 lives and get a new one every 2000 points.

214038.overview: A kart style racing game that incorporates a level of chance wherein the distance you can move around the track is impacted by somewhat random dice rolls, you must avoid track effects like water and use limited bombs effectively to come in first. Striking your opponent from the rear could end up moving them forward. The game was developed by KidStuff ( original game design by D. Robb and S. Pullinger with additional design by B. Carr ) and released via Licenseware in 1994. When you strike a competitor you will hear the children exclaim, "Impact!"

214051.overview:
Interstate is a card game based on Mille Bornes. The game plays as a one-player game, but it is essentially a two-player game where the second player must be computer-controlled. Each player has a hand of seven cards. They take it in turns to either play a card or discard a card, and then draw another card to replace it, until there are no more cards left. The goal of the game is to drive 1000 miles before your opponent. There are cards that have distances you can play (50 miles, 25 miles, 100 miles, etc.) that must, in total, add up to 1000, exactly. However, before you can drive any distance, you first need to play a "Go" card to get out on the road. Your opponent can play a "Stop" card, which means you need to play another "Go" card before you can progress any further. There are also a set of hazard cards, which not only take your opponent off the road but give them something they have to specifically fix: for example, if the "Nail in Tire" card is played on you, you need to play the "Spare Tire" card before you can progress. There are also safety cards that make you immune to a certain kind of hazard. For example, playing the "Steel Tire" card means your opponent can't play a "Nail in Tire" card. There is only one of each kind of safety card in the deck. You can play a safety card at any time, but if you play it while you are afflicted by the corresponding hazard card, you get a special point bonus. Finally, there are wild cards, which can be played as if they were any other kind of card.

The game is controlled with the mouse. You must first click the "Play" or "Discard" button, and then select one of your cards. There are sound effects (and sometimes other effects, like shaking the screen) when a card is played.

214052.overview: An updated version of the Amiga conversion of Mille Bornes. The original came out in 1991 and this version had updates in 1995 and 1998. Try to get 1000 miles before your opponent. There are a set of hazard cards, which not only take your opponent off the road but give them something they have to specifically fix: for example, if the the "Nail in Tire" card is played on you, you need to play the "Spare Tire" card before you can progress. There are also safety cards, that make you immune from a certain kind of hazard. For example, playing the "Steel Tire" card means it is impossible for your opponent to play a "Nail in Tire" card. There is only one of each kind of safety card in the deck. You can play a safety card at any time, but if you play it while you are afflicted by the corresponding hazard card, you get a special point bonus. Finally, there are wild cards, which can be played as if they were any other kind of card.

214053.overview:
A Defender style, space shooter by Zomco, released at 7DX 2015 Demo Party in Turkey. 

Code: doMiNO
Graphics: Squidward
Music: Greg Tuby

214054.overview: A new version of the classic space invaders game with graphics taken from the original created by Blaine Evans and Dave Edwards of Pendle Europa.

214055.overview: A single player puzzle game created by Bode Ode and released as freeware in 1990.

214056.overview: Game designed by Nightowl Software Team. In-game duck animation by Michael O'Young and music/sound FX by Jason Chan. Game statistics by Phillip Wong. Although an option to load add-on disks is available in the game, none were ever released. According to the game manual, the unreleased add-on disks may have included 1995 team updates, batting & fielding practice, Sheffield Shield matches, and an AGA update. Subsequently, it is possible that the standalone update ITS CRICKET (1995 EDITION) may have originally been conceived as an add-on disk.

214975.overview: A hotel manager strategy game with some similarities to Monopoly and the Hotel\Hotel Wars series. The game was created by Gilles Bausch and released to the public domain in 1994.

215063.overview: An overhead racing party game in the style of Super Sprint created by James Carrick and Julian Young of Neurosis. This features one to three players, end game stats and a high score.

215321.overview: A variation on the Ishido game format touted as a contemplative board game. This one was created by Robert Brandner and released in 1992.

215580.overview: In the Beginning is an Educational game, developed and published by MicroED, which was released in Europe in 1988.

217021.overview: Open source 2D old school shooting game for the Amiga OS 4.x with source code available on the web created by the Insanerz team of Marcio Frayze David and Marcelo Baccelli and released on April 16, 2009.

217287.overview: Probably only ever released as part of Gold Disk's AMIGA COMPLETE software compilation, this puzzle game by Adspec Programming was released in 1991.

217541.overview: A Boulder Dash\Emerald Mines game created by El en Vic and released to PD in 1994.

219290.overview: A adventure game about the YU situation created by Peter Bakota and Tibor Csonkas aka Tenax Software.

418221.overview:
In this game you are Rif, a young fox, who is falsely accused of stealing the magical orb of storms. This orb is capable of predicting when storms will arrive. Obviously this is important to farmers, but it is just as important to the boar tribe, for their supply of mud.

You'll have to find the Orb and the real thief, to clear your name, save your girlfriend and prevent war with the boar tribe. While your doing this you'll encounter a much larger mystery: What is the origin of the tribes? Legend has it that the humans gave the animals the power of thought and speech, and then vanished. Who were they and what happened to them?

418402.overview: A Pengo style arcade action game from Hans v. d. Munckhof. It was released 1992-04-03 on Amigo! issue 02/92. Issue 04/92 (1992-08-07) contains extra levels for it. Music is borrowed from the rock classic "Crazy little thing called love" by QUEEN.

420873.overview: A horizontally scrolling space shooter for one player, released as shareware by Vista Software in 1995.

420889.overview: A playable Polish-language adventure game demo created by PioSo in 1995.

421008.overview: An updated and brilliant looking shareware version of missile command created by Pete Storonskij using Blitz Basic in 1993. Destroy the incoming missiles before they take down your cities and your defenses.

421963.overview: Invanoid is an experimental retro game that combines classic Space Invaders and Breakout mechanics into one intense arcade battle. The player controls a paddle at the bottom of the screen, deflecting projectiles and destroying ranks of enemies who are constantly descending.

422094.overview:
An adventure game with pictures and text. Mature themed from Michael Zerbo who released the game as shareware under the horror themed publishing name of ScareWare in 1994, using the Visionary system of game creation. Inner Demons is a shareware text and graphics adventure game designed for entry level players of games of this type. It comes with the warning that it contains graphic descriptions of violence and may not be suitable for young children.

The player is put into the mind of a madman and must either overcome the demons that haunt his life or succumb to them. Eighteen months ago the main character, who is not initially identified, was involved in a serious car crash. He escaped serious injury, however his daughter Patricia was not as fortunate and she perished. Hallucinations and visions followed culminating in a serious mental breakdown. The story starts shortly after his release from a mental institution and subsequent return home to recuperate.

This game's parser system uses small verb/noun sentences such as 'take the rope' or 'use the key' and to make the game easier to play a menu of common commands and keystroke shortcuts is displayed in most locations. Key items in the game are labelled as 'visible objects' which helps to ensure that they are not missed.

422095.overview: A shoot-em-up game based in space, created by V. Elsweiler and T. Tenbergen in 1988.

422100.overview: A challenging vertically scrolling shoot-em-up game made with the Amiga SEUCK and released as public domain. Your mission is to fly your attack interceptor and destroy the enemies that you might rescue all the hostages.

422103.overview: Welcome to operation Winterfox, Lieutenant. Commencing with pre-dropzone procedures. Track down and take out I-SOR agents who are directly responsible for over 35 acts of violence throughout the world and 106 deaths. They have now commandeered a US research station in the antarctic, killing all but one scientist. They demand a nuclear warhead in exchange for the scientist, the base and the tech stored there.  This is not an option. Your objectives are 1. Rescue R. Markely, he is a high value asset. 2. eliminate the I-SOR agents.

422108.overview: Take part in this text/picture based AMOS shareware adventure game. You start in a dungeon cell, you must escape the dungeons, find the proof against the government and stop the drug leader.

422109.overview: Shoot the little red robots! Go berzerk killing the robotrons! Game gives codes at the end of sections so you can restart where you left off...killing robots.

422118.overview: A strategy shareware game by Colin Edwards, released in 1990. This is a business game, deal with shares and make your fortune. The Insider's Club is a light-hearted game of yuppie capitalism. It s quite funny to Think you’re doing well, only to see that the computer opponent has bought half the companies in sight and has £50 million in the bank. That's life,.. We'll beat it one day.

422134.overview:
The FBI sends an agent to deal with cannibals on a desert island. I was a Cannibal for the FBI is an open-source freeware text adventure. It has a basic parser without the standard features of the older Infocom one like recognition of chain commands and adverbs.

The game's main objective is to escape the island and avoid being eaten by the cannibals.

The Amiga version was originally distributed in an appendix for a book about programming (the handbook for the Visionary Interactive Editor, included with the software) by John Olsen, the game's author.

One main difference is in the use of the mouse, as objects can only be taken by dragging and dropping them on windows. Objects and places can also be examined by clicking them on the picture and inventory windows.

The inventory window at the top-right of the screen holds a maximum of 6 objects. Objects on the room appear either embedded on the location or inside a strip at the right of the picture window. Below the inventory there is a click-able compass and besides it the up and down buttons. Blocked directions have a muted color, while the possible exits have a normal color. Below the compass, there are five buttons: HELP (displays some basic information regarding the interface), DIG (to unearth objects when possible), LOAD (loads the saved game), SAVE (saves the game) and QUIT (exits the game).

422135.overview: Use the cross hair to shoot various bugs that move across the screen at various speeds. A PD game from James Hall, created in 1992.

422150.overview:
Pentti-Antero Sillanköykäys has been severely disabled for his whole life. After his 27th birthday he starts seeing prophetic dreams which help him to miraculously cure himself. He feels an urge to contribute something back to the society and starts a taxi service for the disabled; the Inva-taxi.

Even though Inva-taxi was originally meant to be a simple joke, it was one of those games that spread in Finnish BBS systems. The gameplay is based on a unique feature: speech recognition by the player. The player listens to the incomprehensible mongling of instructions given by disabled people and tries to select the right destination for the taxi ride. There really isn't any more content in the game than listening to the samples and clicking the right spot on the map.

422216.overview: Iron Clads: The Game of Surface Naval Combat 1901-1945 is a freeware, 2 player, turned based strategy wargame created by Ashley Sear in Hisoft Basic and released on February 8, 1992 and placed on public domain May 16, 1992. The purpose of the game is to simulate surface naval warfare in the early part of the 20th century, ending with the conclusion of World War II.

422737.overview:
ICBM3D ("Inter-Continental Ballistic Missiles, 3D") is a 3D game of defense.
Like the original "Missile Command" and its clones, this game places you in
control of Anti-ICBM weapons which you use to destroy an onslaught of
missiles (and other nasties) which are dropping onto your nation.
The game ends when your cities have all been destroyed. You only gain
replacement cities by acheiving certain score thresholds during each attack

422777.overview:
Five of the most powerful and influential beings in the galaxy meet on board the orbiting space station of Far Funus. Their declared intention is to bring peace to the galaxy by settling their differences, over the negotiating table, diplomatically. Secretly, each of these warlike beings hopes to outwit the other four and seize control of the galaxy for his empire once and for all. There's Bezel from the Pirate Empire resplendent in his burgundy and magenta robes but a creature none of the others would trust as far as they could have thrown his feared and awesome ship, the good vessel Vespozian. All of the others are at a disadvantage when haughty Shazaz-Ka looks them in the eye. They dare not return the stare of this subtle diplomat from the powerful Sun Empire, for fear of being permanently blinded. 

He uses this advantage sparingly but his terrible frown falls most regularly on the ill-mannered Bezel. In contrast, the brutish gesturing and roaring from infamously ill- tempered Tiaithan Lizard delegate Maachen, threatens to disrupt the proceedings at every turn. The others excuse his behaviour by making allowances for his being out of his natural amphibious environment but they are not so quick to dismiss the threat his numerous blue-emblemed Water Empire forces pose. No-one has ever discovered the name of the anonymous Ice Warrior, whose features remain hidden behind a glacier mask and whose grating voice is disguised by the crackling breathing apparatus that serves him on this mission. 


He represents the weak and much-scattered Dead Empire, whose voice at these proceedings is only heard because no other empire can take control of the inhospitable planets and dying stars where they live. But while they look down on the primitive resources of the Dead Empire and the irony that these most lifeless of beings have chosen vibrant green as the distinguishing colour of their poorly-equipped fleets, the others keep one wary eye on his ice-axe. And all know the value of an ally capable of inhabiting planets where no-one else can visit - let alone live. Lastly comes Grakta of the Bloodline Empire. 
Traditionally the rulers of this galaxy and let none estimate his cunning which is the result of 27 generations of careful cloning. His power relies on the Bloodline's long control of the stellar energy, but now it is under fierce attack from all sides - yet knowing Grakta he may still win the day. The five are sat around a board, with their base stars, outlying stars and fleets on it. As the fortunes of galactic war ebb and flow before them they argue, connive, ally and betray to gain the upper hand for their respective empires. Any is capable of wresting complete control, but each must use the others in brief alliances, all will try to prevent any other from becoming too powerful. It's diplomacy on a cosmic scale for two-five players and no holds are barred.

422924.overview:
A shareware game from Rudiger Hanke created with Mipric in 1994. In this fairytale adventure you take the role of an unhappy, runaway orphan boy. The game starts on a cold Christmas Eve morning in a snow covered landscape in some faraway village.

Standing near a frozen lake, you suddenly see the most beautiful young girl you have ever seen, and you immediately fall head over heels in love with her! Your task becomes to find this "princess" who has stolen your heart.

422939.overview: An unfinished AMOS based, freeware adventure game from James Kaylor in 1995.

423070.overview: A text adventure called "In Distress at Sea" in English, this German language game starts as a storm rose up behind Bermuda. Long waves rolled towards your ship from two sides, hit the sides and joined together. The wind came up, whistled through the rigging and billowed out the sail. Within minutes it was so dark that you could no longer distinguish the sky from the water. You had never experienced such an abrupt change in the weather in all your years at sea. The mast must have broken at some point. You may not remember exactly when you wanted to take in the sail. All you remember is a deafening clap of thunder, then everything went black. Maybe the mast fell on you, or a breaker threw you against the railing - in any case, you lost consciousness. Now the sun is high in the sky again. Your skull hurts, but otherwise you survived the storm uninjured. That cannot be said about your sailboat. Begin and remember to conserve your strength.

423151.overview:
This program is about making as much profit as possible with a sausage stand. To begin with, the TOP 28 sausage stall owners appear on the screen. You can then enter the number of players 9), their names and the number of weeks you want to work (1-9). 
 
After these entries, the main menu screen appears. In the upper one-half of the screen shows the snack bar owner, the day of the week, the temperature and the cash register contents. Below there is a display of the current inventory and the sales and purchase prices of the items. Weekdays: Purchasing goods is only possible from Monday to Friday. 
 
The number of customers is heavier on weekends. Depending on the temperature, warm or cold foods sell better. The purchase prices also depend on the temperature. (e.g. the price of ice cream increases at a temperature of 35 degrees). Every player now has the opportunity to buy goods (except on weekends) and to change the prices. All you MUST do is click on the corresponding fields with the mouse (+1/-1 for the quantity, and +100/-100, +10/-10 for the sales price). The purchased quantity can be set back to -1, but only the quantity that was purchased in this round (i.e. it is not possible to sell goods to the supplier). buy). The player can buy as much as there is money in the cash register. When all purchases have been made, you can click OK and the next player can make the purchases. After all players are finished, the snack bars open to the customers.

448822.overview:
The text adventure "I Rescued Elvis from Communist Alien Jerks!" is a sci-fi comedy about alien abduction. The introductory text is set after the events of the game: the main character arrives shaken and dazed at a local bar, meets up with a friend and -- beer in hand -- starts describing what just happened to them. The game then begins in flashback shortly before the protagonist was abducted: in the dead of night, while they were standing out in an Alabama cornfield.

"I Rescued Elvis..." was created using the Dream Weaver authoring system (not to be confused with Adobe Dreamweaver). The interface is similar to adventure games produced by Legend Entertainment in the early 1990s such as Spellcasting 101 and Eric the Unready, where about a quarter of the screen is used to show the actual game text, then there is a small static picture of the current scene (shown from first-person perspective), and the rest of the screen is filled with helpful GUI gadgets that the player can use instead of manually typing in commands. There are clickable arrows for the main compass directions (and up/down movement), action buttons (look at, take, drop, etc.) along with a list of less-common actions the player might want to try (search, smash, sit on), and two lists of available objects: one for objects in the current room, and one for inventory objects the player is carrying, with a toggle button to switch between them.

455663.overview:
Impact is an old break-out style game. The user controls a paddle and needs to catch a ball with the paddle each time it comes down. When the ball hits a brick, it is destroyed (unless it's made undestroyable). Sometimes, a bonus will come out of the brick. This adds to the 'bonus score'. When the player collected one or more bonuses, he may 'release' them, and he receives a powerup. Each 'bonus score' has a different powerup: the most powerful powerups need the largest number of bonus points. Impact comes with a lot of levels and a level editor.

The game was re-released in 1995 adding 48 new levels.

455748.overview: Impact Armor Alpha is an old school mecha platform game from the snes, megadrive era, like Assault Suits Valken (Cybernator), Front Mission:Gun Hazard and Ranger-X.

456259.overview: International Kopicat Plus is an AMIGA version of the classic memory game SIMON, an electronic game from Milton Bradley (MB) launched in the United States in 1978, invented by Ralph Baer and Howard J. Morrison.

472052.overview:
All aboard! Iron Rails is a railway strategy game exclusively for the Commodore Amiga, inspired by the classic board game genre of route-building and destination racing.

Take command of your railway empire across a sprawling map of North America. Collect train cards, claim routes between cities, and secretly complete destination tickets before your rivals do. Every decision matters — do you claim that key route now, or hold your cards for a longer, higher-scoring connection?

477182.overview:
A cyberpunk interactive-fiction game for the Amiga, in English and French.
You are CORBEAU, a hacker. At 04h12, on the thirty-first day of rain, forty kilometres of coast off Bergen lie black with crude - and TETHYS Petrochem calls it somebody else's fault. A contact needs proof, not rumour: three documents, pulled from inside the TETHYS network, before the story runs at 06h00. You have no face. Just a node number and a debt.

482062.overview:
Classic LucasArts adventures Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis have received lovely new 256-colour AGA enhancements for the Amiga 1200 by dlfrsilver.

Indiana Jones is back! The great archaeologist and adventurer has to solve a grand mystery once again, aided by his trusty whip, his sharp wit, and his courage. A man who calls himself Mr. Smith is interested in a certain ancient statue. When the unsuspecting Indy hands it over to the client, he finds out that Mr. Smith is in fact a colonel in the Nazi army! Why was he so interested in that statue? A young woman who had once worked together with Indy, the pretty red-haired (and a bit troublesome) Sophia, tells him the whole thing must have a connection with the legendary lost continent Atlantis. Gathering clues from all over the world, Indy and Sophia embark on a grand journey across the globe.

482063.overview:
Classic LucasArts adventures Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade have received lovely new 256-colour AGA enhancements for the Amiga 1200 by dlfrsilver

Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Graphic Adventure is a graphic adventure game, originally released in 1989 (to coincide with the release of the film of the same name), published by Lucasfilm Games (now LucasArts). It was the third game to use the SCUMM engine.
